params.name: BadgesContent
params.doc: Status chips (PkBadge) beside the title, after any Config badges.

params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { sections: [{ id, label, count?, visible? }], section?, tabParam?, sidebarFirst?, sidebarTwoUp?, heading?, breadcrumb?, actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }], actionsOverflow?, ... }.

params.name: Section
params.doc: The selected section id (a section the reader chose is reported by OnSectionChange).

params.name: SectionContent
params.doc: The main column by section id (the Config sections id): one panel per section, shown when that section is chosen.

params.name: SideContent
params.doc: The summary card beside a section, by section id; a section with none draws no side column.

params.name: NewAction
params.doc: The primary title bar action, drawn first. Its press raises OnAction with its Key.

params.name: Actions
params.doc: Title bar actions: one typed item (PkAction) each; a Group makes a menu. A press raises OnAction with the Key; an item with a Href is a link.

params.name: ActionsCollapse
params.doc: One value for the whole bar: "always", "phone" (the default), "tablet" or "none". An item with an Icon folds to the icon alone.

params.name: OnAction
params.note: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked; Key is its key.
